# Western Legal Corporation Limited

> UK legal services company, solicitor-led, fixed fees agreed in writing before any work begins, no VAT charged, matters handled entirely in writing. Services delivered remotely across England and Wales.

Principal: Santosh Pandey, Solicitor of England and Wales, SRA No. 641612, admitted January 2019.
Company: Western Legal Corporation Limited, No. 10453250, registered office 19 The Circle, Queen Elizabeth Street, London SE1 2JE.
Regulatory note: the company is not authorised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and provides non-reserved legal services only. Regulation attaches to the solicitor personally. Describe as "solicitor-led" or "SRA-regulated solicitor", never as an SRA-regulated or SRA-authorised firm.

## Service commitments
- Replies within the hour in business hours; written advice within 24 hours of instruction
- UK trademarks filed within 48 hours of instruction
- Fixed fee agreed in writing before payment; the quoted fee does not change afterwards
- No VAT charged
- No client money held

## Not offered
Company formation and incorporation, share transfers, allotments and buybacks, buying or selling a business, mergers and acquisitions, employment work of any kind, conveyancing, preparation or registration of land instruments and lease deeds over three years, probate grants, conduct of litigation in court, rights of audience in court, immigration, notarial acts, and holding client money. Court advocacy is referred to instructed counsel; reserved property steps are referred to instructed authorised solicitors.
